title: KPI
description: One headline number with an optional change indicator and trend line.
x-use-when: The user wants a single headline metric at a point in time: a total, count, average, or rate (open AR, tickets this week, win rate).
x-dont-use-when: Several values need comparing across categories (use bar_chart) or the user needs individual records (use table).
x-checks: Warns when a percent value looks like a whole number (45 instead of 0.45).
Warns when a percent delta looks like a whole number (8.2 instead of 0.082).

value.description: The metric as a raw number, never pre-formatted text. Use null when there is no data and explain why in note.

format.description: How value is displayed. percent expects a fraction: 0.45 shows as 45%. Values of 10,000 or more are abbreviated ($412.3K).

value.description: The change. With format percent (the default), a fraction: 0.082 shows as +8.2%.

format.description: percent shows a percentage change. value shows the change in the KPI's own format, e.g. +$12.4K.

label.description: What the change is measured against, e.g. "vs last month".

good_direction.description: Whether an increase is good (revenue: up) or bad (overdue AR: down). Controls green vs red.

sparkline.description: Optional trend, oldest first, ending with the current value. Shows shape only, no axis.
